entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold for ten minutes. I want to return this helmet I bought. This is completely unacceptable.

I certainly understand your frustration with the wait time, and I can help you with the return. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's the wrong color! I ordered black, not this weird gray. It looks nothing like the picture. For the price I paid, I expect to get what I ordered. I haven't even taken it out of the packaging; the box is completely unopened.
I'm very sorry to hear that the color wasn't what you expected. I know how important that is. Let me just pull up your order information to check the return eligibility.
There shouldn't be anything to 'check.' Just process the return. If you don't, I want to speak to your manager. I'm one step away from leaving a review about this on every website I can find.
I understand your urgency. I'm just confirming the details on my end... Okay, I see the order. The helmet was delivered 8 days ago. We're well within the 90-day return window for this item.

Yes, absolutely. Since the box is unopened and you're within the policy timeframe, I can process this for a full refund for you right now. I just need to email you a prepaid shipping label. Is the email on file correct?
Oh. Okay... yes, the email is correct. So it's a free return?

That's correct. I've just sent that label to you. Simply print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be issued. We want to make sure you have gear you feel good about, especially when it comes to your safety.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
